name: Final Embrace Horror
prerequisites: Str 15, Int 3; naga, serpentfolk, or creature that has the constrict special attack; Final Embrace; base attack bonus +6
benefit:
A creature that takes damage from your constrict attack is also shaken until the start of your next turn.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 119
When a creature is damaged by your constrict ability, you can spend 5 stamina points to sicken that creature until the start of your next turn.
flavor: Your constricting attack has become stronger and more lethal.
